headline: GTA 6 Release Sparks Economic and Productivity Discussion
summary: The release of 'Grand Theft Auto VI' has prompted significant consumer interest, with reports suggesting nearly one-fifth of workers may take time off, impacting productivity and Take-Two Interactive's stock outlook.
why: Major entertainment product launches can have measurable impacts on consumer spending and short-term labor productivity, while also serving as a key revenue driver for the parent company.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive
impacts.why: High anticipation and strong critical reception for a major title typically support the stock price of the publisher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
